name: EU Financial Markets & Corporate Sustainability (CSRD / MiFID II)
description: Compliance framework for EU financial market regulations including MiFID II / MiFIR, Market Abuse Regulation (MAR), Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), and Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR).
owner: EU Regulatory Affairs & ESG Compliance Office

checklists.name: EU Financial Markets & CSRD Compliance Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for EU MAR insider lists, MiFID II trade recording, and CSRD ESG reporting standards.

items.statement: Insider lists comply with MAR Article 18 layout and update immediately upon new inside information discovery.
MiFID II transaction reports record trade execution details within T+1 to national competent authorities (NCAs).
CSRD double materiality evaluation assesses both financial impacts and environmental/social impacts.
SFDR disclosures for Article 8/9 funds publish PAI (Principal Adverse Impact) indicators on public web portals.

reviewGates.name: EU Financial Markets Attestation Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Head of Regulatory Compliance confirms that MAR insider tracking, MiFID II reporting, and CSRD ESG data meet EU directives.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the regulatory audit evidence verify full compliance with EU MAR, MiFID II, and CSRD directives?
